notes.title: A new visual novel in the style of Find someone else
notes.content:
If you liked Find someone else you might be interested in my latest release: Pandemic Love. It's a dark visual novel about a person being isolated during a quarantine, while meeting and befriending different characters from a distance.

You could call it a companion piece to Find someone else that shares some gameplay elements, graphical style, as well as themes. If you think you would find that interesting, you can always check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1558900/Pandemic_Love/]here on Steam.[/url] It's free.
